# `Q-5-50` — Invalid drafts Pattern

> A `drafts` entry is not a path, points outside the project, or is
> not a valid glob. It marks nothing as a draft.

## What this means

`drafts` (or `website.drafts`) lists pages to treat as drafts, as if
each said `draft: true`. Every entry is a path or glob pattern,
resolved relative to the file it is written in (a leading `/` anchors
it at the project root). This warning means one entry could not be
used:

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
website:
  drafts:
    - posts/wip.qmd        # fine
    - "posts/*.qmd"        # fine: a glob
    - ../elsewhere.qmd     # Q-5-50: climbs above the project root
    - "posts/[.qmd"        # Q-5-50: not a valid glob
    - {path: x.qmd}        # Q-5-50: not a path
```

The entry is ignored. The other entries still apply.

## How to fix it

Write each entry as a path or glob pattern that stays inside the
project directory.
